guides.favoredWhen: Malphite wins Q-poke attrition, Bramble timing, and R-for-R trades; Aatrox wins full Q combos and W-chain all-ins.

keyTips.text: Use Q poke as the main lane pattern. Ranged harass is your safe damage; never take close trades you do not need.
keyTips.heading: Poke pattern

keyTips.text: Rush early Bramble Vest. His combo autos trigger the heal cut, so the item must be online before his first real all-in, not after.
keyTips.heading: Bramble rush

keyTips.text: Answer his ultimate with your own. When he ults to all-in, meet it with R; the exchange stays manageable instead of one-sided.
keyTips.heading: Ult answer

tips.text: If Q1 lands, be ready to absorb the full combo. His sequence is hard to avoid once started, so shield up and ride it out rather than flashing into worse.
tips.heading: Combo respect

tips.text: Keep Q movement speed cycling so he never gets a clean W combo. He looks for the engage as your speed fades, so reposition the moment it expires.
tips.heading: Speed discipline

tips.text: Leave his W zone with Q speed plus tier-two boots. The combination walks you out before Q2 lands; without it, the chain completes.
tips.heading: W escape

tips.text: Take short W plus E trades, then back away. Stack armor until his penetration item lands; before Serylda's or Cleaver, your armor wins the exchange.
tips.heading: Short trades

tips.text: Group after one item instead of side-laning. Your teamfight R decides more than a split exchange, so convert the spike into grouped fights.
tips.heading: Group timing

tips.text: Watch his shield timer before committing. Strike as his passive shield fades rather than into it, so your combo lands on bare health.
tips.heading: Shield watch

itemization.text: Prioritize early Bramble Vest into Plated Steelcaps and armor. Delay damage until his penetration purchase forces the resistance race.

keyTips.text: Absorb short trades on the passive shield, then back off cleanly until it recharges off damage.
Treat R as the entire hard engage; without it available, no other hard control exists.
Build enough defense to live after R entries instead of assuming the knock-up alone wins fights.

tips.text: Slow targets with Q while stealing their movement speed for follow-up or disengage windows.
Open trades from range with Q, then ride the stolen movement speed for better spacing.
Trade inside the W armor window, tripled while the passive shield holds.
Answer committing auto attackers with E for its attack-speed cut.
Seek auto-attack-heavy and AD opponents as favorable lanes, leaning on W armor there.
Dodge extended exchanges into AP-heavy opponents while defenses stay mostly armor.
Aim R at grouped targets to cash its area knock-up as teamfight initiation.
Follow R engages with E for the attack-speed cut, then W empowered attacks inside range.
Bank R for approaching objective fights over low-value solo plays.
Start team fights with R, then stay close to spread E attack-speed cuts across enemy carries.
Prioritize AD and frequent basic attackers when choosing engage spots and targets.
Refuse forced fights with R down whenever the team needs his initiation.

itemization.text: Run Grasp of the Undying with Font of Life, Conditioning, and Overgrowth plus Manaflow Band and Gathering Storm for sustain and durability.
Start Doran's Shield or Doran's Ring, showing Bami's Cinder on AD-lane first recalls and Null-Magic Mantle plus Ruby Crystal into AP lanes.
Core Sunfire Aegis and Unending Despair.
Build the standard tank set: Mercury's Treads, Jak'Sho, Abyssal Mask, and Thornmail.
Pivot toward Plated Steelcaps, Thornmail, Frozen Heart, and Death's Dance into heavy AD.
Pivot toward Mercury's Treads, Hollow Radiance, Abyssal Mask, Force of Nature, Banshee's Veil, and Wit's End into heavy AP.
Keep the AP burst build of Sorcerer's Shoes, Malignance, Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, and Void Staff fully separate.
